text.config.villagerretaliation.option.c: Include All Villagers
Makes every eligible villager use the downed system. When enabled, the raid, hired, and party-specific switches below no longer narrow eligibility.
Minimum Downed Time
Minimum time in ticks before a downed villager can recover, even when the area is safe.
Required Safe Time
Continuous time in ticks without a nearby threat before a downed villager can recover.
Recovery Health
Fraction of maximum health restored when a downed villager gets back up.
Threat Detection Radius
Radius in blocks checked for threats that prevent a downed villager from recovering.
Downed Villager System
Allows selected villagers to become incapacitated and recover instead of dying immediately.
Environmental Damage Can Down Villagers
Allows eligible villagers to enter the downed state after fall, fire, drowning, and other environmental damage.
Include Hired Villagers
Includes hired workers when Include All Villagers is off.
Mob Damage Can Down Villagers
Allows eligible villagers to enter the downed state when damaged by mobs.
Include Party Villagers
Includes villagers in a player party when Include All Villagers is off.
Player Damage Can Down Villagers
Allows eligible villagers to enter the downed state when damaged by a player.
Include Raid Villagers
Includes village defenders during Player Raids when Include All Villagers is off.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.d: Share Personal Dialogue Nearby
Lets nearby players see dialogue that originated from another player's personal interaction session.
Chat Audience
Chooses who receives villager chat messages outside the interaction screen.
Nearby Chat Radius
Maximum distance in blocks for Nearby Players chat. This has no effect on the other audience modes.
Arena Radius
Maximum distance in blocks a duelist may move from the duel center.
Boundary Grace Time
Time in ticks a duelist may remain outside the arena before forfeiting.
Duel Cooldown
Minecraft days before the same villager can be challenged again.
Villager Duels
Allows eligible villagers to accept non-lethal duel challenges.
Minimum Guts
Minimum Guts attribute a villager needs before they will consider a duel.
Losses Before Refusal
Number of recent losses after which a villager refuses another challenge.
Maximum Spectators
Maximum number of nearby villagers that can watch one duel. Set to 0 to disable spectators.
Spectator Search Radius
Radius in blocks used to find villagers who may watch a duel.
Duel Time Limit
Maximum duel duration in ticks before the duel ends automatically.
Spectator Reputation Gain
Reputation gained with each villager that watches a completed duel.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.q: Chooses whether item highlights use every active quest or only the quest currently tracked in the HUD.
Shows an animated exclamation mark above villagers when one of their existing quests has an unacknowledged update, including in the interaction screen.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.p: Number of village defenders needed for each naturally allocated iron golem.
Maximum number of village iron golems assigned to defend against a Player Raid.
Minimum number of village iron golems assigned to defend against a Player Raid.
Number of participating players required to add one bonus defending iron golem.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.b: Baby Villagers Drop Loot
Reserved for pack authors. VillagerRetaliation v1 hard-enforces no custom loot from baby villagers.
Skill Growth from Hired Work
Allows successful, measurable hired work to split its existing practice XP budget between the role's primary and support skills at 70%% and 30%%.
Builder Base Construction Cost
Base currency cost added to every confirmed construction job.
Builder Can Replace Soft Blocks
Allows builders to replace grass, flowers, snow layers, saplings, and other non-solid replaceable blocks at the build site.
Builder Cost Per 64 Blocks
Additional construction cost per 64 non-air template blocks.
Builder Material Storage Radius
Maximum distance assigned construction-block storage may be from the build-site footprint.
Builder Max Structure Blocks
Maximum number of non-air template blocks a hired builder may place for one structure.
Builder Max Site Distance
Maximum distance from the hirer or builder when choosing an automatic build site without a work area.
Hired Contract Base Daily Cost
Base emerald cost per hired contract day before skill and reputation adjustments.
Hired Contract Despised Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for despised-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Early End Refund Percent
Percent of the remaining paid contract value refunded when ending a contract early.
Hired Contract Feared Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for feared-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Hostile Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for hostile-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Maximum Daily Cost
Highest possible emerald cost per hired contract day after adjustments.
Hired Contract Minimum Daily Cost
Lowest possible emerald cost per hired contract day after adjustments.
Hired Contract Neutral Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for neutral-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Respected Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for respected-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Revered Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for revered-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Royalty Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for royalty-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Skill Premium Per Ten
Extra emeralds per day for each 10 aptitude points above the standard aptitude of 60 in a villager's best hired role.
Hired Contract Suspicious Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for suspicious-tier reputation.
Hired Contract Trusted Cost Modifier
Daily emerald adjustment for trusted-tier reputation.
Hired Work Base Efficiency Percent
Configured baseline for general work cadence before role-specific cadence, mood, missing-tool penalties, and clamps. Capacity, block speed, fishing, and combat skill effects are applied separately.
Hired Work Default Radius
Default horizontal work radius before role-specific and player-selected limits are applied.
Hired Work Maximum Efficiency Percent
Upper clamp for operational cadence after role cadence, mood, and missing-tool penalties. Concrete capacity, block, fishing, and combat effects are applied separately.
Hired Work Maximum Radius
Maximum horizontal radius a hired worker may use.
Hired Work Minimum Efficiency Percent
Lower clamp for operational cadence after role cadence, mood, and missing-tool penalties. Concrete capacity, block, fishing, and combat effects are applied separately.
Hired Work Notice Cooldown
Minimum seconds between blocked-storage notices and the base cooldown for routine hired-worker progress. Routine progress waits at least ten minutes.
Animal Handling Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful breeding, product collection, or culling unit.
Brewing Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successfully collected brewing output unit.
Builder Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful block placement, transformation, or obstruction-clearing unit.
Combat Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized unit of valid damage dealt by a hired guard or hunter.
Cooking Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successfully produced cooking output unit.
Craftsman Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful craftsman recipe output unit.
Farming Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful harvest, replant, planting, or tilling unit.
Logging Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful tree-harvest unit.
Mining Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful mining or smelting work unit.
Fishing Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized successful fishing catch or courier delivery unit.
Nitwit Job Skill Growth
Skill XP per normalized completed nitwit report; waiting and walking grant none.
Hired Work Tick Interval

Baseline ticks between hired-worker decisions at 100%% operational efficiency. Only roles whose aptitude represents action cadence modify this interval; other skills change their concrete role effect instead.
Hunger Effect Affects Villagers
Makes the vanilla Hunger status effect drain a villager's food and saturation using the same exhaustion rate as players.
Profession Drop Chance
Chance for adult villagers to roll their profession-specific loot pool.
Rare Drop Chance
Chance used by rare profession drops.
Require Player Kill For Profession Loot
Requires a player-caused kill before profession-specific villager loot can roll.
Very Rare Drop Chance
Chance used by very rare profession drops.
Villager Bread Drop Chance
Chance for adult villagers to drop 1-3 bread.
Villager Emerald Drop Chance
Chance for adult villagers to drop 1-5 emeralds.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.c: Armorers Fight Back
Allows armorers to retaliate and gain short defensive resistance.
Armorer Shield Chance (Hard)
Chance for armorers to spawn with an offhand shield (hard mode only).
Butchers Fight Back
Allows butchers to retaliate with melee behavior.
Clerics Use Potions
Allows clerics to retaliate defensively and use regeneration when hurt.
Combat Weapon Drop Chance
Chance for temporary retaliation main-hand weapons to drop on villager death.
Combat Weapon Enchant Chance
Chance for temporary retaliation main-hand weapons to be enchanted (hard mode only).
Heal After Sleeping
When enabled, villagers that successfully sleep through the night recover up to the configured health threshold after waking.
Fletchers Fight Back
Allows fletchers to retaliate, including simple ranged shots.
Hostile Villagers Throw Items
Allows villagers who view a player as HOSTILE or worse to occasionally throw harmless eggs or poisonous potatoes.
Hostile Tier Harass Throw Max Interval Ticks
Maximum ticks between hostile-tier harassment throws.
Hostile Tier Harass Throw Min Interval Ticks
Minimum ticks between hostile-tier harassment throws.
Natural Hostile Target Radius
Maximum range in blocks for villagers and wandering traders to proactively target visible hostile mobs. The explicit hostile mob targeting toggles must also be enabled.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Health Threshold
Health ratio below which idle clerics consider an ally injured enough to heal.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Range
Maximum range in blocks for idle clerics to look for injured villagers or wandering traders.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Requires Line Of Sight
When true, idle clerics only heal allies they can already see, preventing long wall-hugging path attempts.
Toolsmiths Fight Back
Allows toolsmiths to retaliate with melee behavior.
Villagers Flee Visible Creepers
Makes villagers avoid visible creepers instead of trying to fight them.
Villager Sleep Healing Max Health Percent
Maximum fraction of a villager's health restored after successful sleep. Villagers already above this threshold are not harmed.
Villagers Pick Up Ground Weapons
Allows villagers to pick up nearby dropped weapons while threatened.
Villagers Retaliate Against Hostile Mobs
Allows adult villagers damaged by hostile mobs to fight back. Disable to keep monster encounters closer to vanilla fleeing behavior.
Villagers Stand Ground Against Hostile Mobs
Allows armed villagers to suppress vanilla panic and stand their ground against hostile mobs. Disable if villagers should usually keep fleeing monsters.
Villagers Target Hostile Mobs
Allows adult villagers to proactively target visible hostile mobs.
Wandering Traders Pick Up Ground Weapons
Allows wandering traders to pick up nearby dropped weapons while threatened.
Wandering Traders Retaliate Against Hostile Mobs
Allows wandering traders damaged by hostile mobs to fight back.
Wandering Traders Target Hostile Mobs
Allows wandering traders to proactively target visible hostile mobs.
Weaponsmiths Fight Back
Allows weaponsmiths to retaliate with stronger melee behavior.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.d: Debug Preview Max Visible Labels
Maximum nearby debug text labels drawn at once. Set to 0 to hide debug-preview labels.
Debug Preview Max Visible Nodes
Maximum route-node markers drawn by clipboard and hitbox debug previews. Set to 0 to hide route-node markers.
Debug Preview Max Visible Segments
Maximum terrain-following route segments drawn by clipboard and hitbox debug previews. Set to 0 to hide route lines.
Highlight Raid Defenders
Makes every loaded villager still tracked as a Player Raid defender glow. Disabled by default.
Reputation Debug Overlay Max Distance
Maximum distance in blocks for the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Only When Sneaking
Requires the local player to be sneaking for the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Require Advanced Tooltips
Requires advanced tooltips (F3+H) for the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Armor
Shows the current armor value under the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Health
Shows current and maximum health under the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Hunger
Shows current and maximum hunger under the overhead reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Number
Shows the reputation number in the debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Tier
Shows the reputation tier in the debug overlay.
Show Village Bounds
Shows tracked village POI-section outlines and the village name while you are inside. Disabled by default.
Show Quest Journal Tags
Shows developer-facing quest metadata tags in journal details. Disabled by default.
Show Villager Reputation Debug Overlay
Renders per-villager reputation toward the local player above villager heads. Disabled by default.
Animate Cinematic Bars
Moves the black bars in and out with the villager interaction screen.
Container Forced Dialogue Trigger
When watched containers should trigger forced dialogue: THEFT_ONLY waits until items are removed, OPENING triggers as soon as the container is opened.
Container Watch Mode

Which containers can trigger watched-container dialogue: GENERATED_LOOT_ONLY only watches generated loot tables listed under data/*/generated_containers, ALL_WATCHED_CONTAINERS also watches blocks in #villagerretaliation:watched_containers without loot tables.
Dialogue Blip Max Pitch
Highest random pitch used for each dialogue line's blip sound.
Dialogue Blip Min Pitch
Lowest random pitch used for each dialogue line's blip sound.
Dialogue Blip Volume
Volume for the dialogue blip sound played while villager text appears.
Dialogue Camera Transition Ticks
Ticks used to ease into the dialogue FOV zoom.
Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount
FOV zoom amount used by forced dialogue and dialogue entries that explicitly force the camera toward a villager.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Height
Pixel height of each black cinematic bar on the villager interaction screen.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Max Slant
Highest horizontal-edge slant in pixels sampled when a villager interaction opens. Positive values lower the right side.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Min Slant
Lowest horizontal-edge slant in pixels sampled when a villager interaction opens. Negative values lower the left side.
Dialogue Positive Reputation Cooldown Days
Minimum Minecraft day changes between positive dialogue reputation gains for the same player and villager.
Dialogue Text Speed
How quickly villager dialogue appears in the interaction menu. Click the dialogue text area to reveal the current line instantly.
Simplify Dialogue Text Effects
Disables animated and stylized dialogue text for a calmer, easier-to-read presentation.
Watched-Container Dialogue
Enables watched-container forced dialogue and theft/opening chat.
React When Containers Open
When true, villagers can react immediately when watched containers are opened. Disable this to keep theft and breaking reactions without the opening interjection.
Dialogue Blip Audio
Plays quiet blips as villager dialogue text appears in the interaction menu.
Cinematic Camera Focus
Focuses the camera during event-driven cinematic dialogue. Regular interaction dialogue has its own camera-focus setting below.
Cinematic Bars
Shows black cinematic bars while the villager interaction screen is open.
Dialogue Affects Reputation
Allows villager dialogue choices to apply small reputation changes.
Event-Driven Dialogue
Enables event-driven forced dialogue such as witnessed retaliation and watched-container confrontations.
Villager Interaction Screen
Opens Villager Retaliation's interaction screen before adult villager trading.
Camera Focus for Regular Dialogue
Focuses the camera during regular player-started dialogue. Event-driven cinematic dialogue uses the main camera-focus setting above.
Quest-Item Proximity Dialogue
Enables forced dialogue and chat callouts when nearby players carry matching held or worn items.
Retaliation Dialogue
Enables forced dialogue and combat barks when villagers begin retaliation.
First Greeting Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible first greeting.
First Insult Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when the first conversation starts with an insult.
Keep Villager Still During Dialogue
Stops villager navigation while a Villager Retaliation dialogue conversation is active.
Gift Annoyance Reduction Divisor
Positive gift reputation value needed to reduce repeated dialogue annoyance by one use. Set to 0 to disable gift annoyance reduction.
Greeting Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible friendly greeting.
Insult Reputation Loss
Reputation lost from an insult.
Interaction Chat Position
Where chat is anchored while the Villager Retaliation interaction menu is open.
Joke Reputation Gain
Reputation gained when a joke lands well.
Joke Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when a joke lands badly.
Max Dialogue Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a dialogue conversation closes.
Max Follow Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a following villager stops following.
Max Forced Dialogue Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a forced dialogue conversation closes.
Normal Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount
FOV zoom amount for regular villager conversations. Forced dialogue still uses Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount.
Question Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible question.
Repeated Dialogue Option Reset Ticks
Game ticks before repeated dialogue option usage resets. Usage also resets at the start of each Minecraft day.
Repeated Question Positive Limit
Consecutive Question dialogue uses that can still grant positive reputation before the villager gets tired of it.
Repeated Question Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when the player keeps repeating Question dialogue after the positive limit.
Respected Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Respected villagers get annoyed.
Revered Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Revered villagers get annoyed.
Royalty Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Royalty-tier villagers get annoyed.
Separate Each Chat Message
Adds a blank chat line between consecutive villager dialogue messages for readability.
Separate Chat by Speaker
Adds a blank chat line before a villager dialogue header when the speaker changes.
Sneak-Click Opens Vanilla Trading
Allows sneaking while right-clicking an adult villager to bypass the interaction screen and open normal trading.
Story Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible story interaction.
Trusted Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Trusted villagers get annoyed.
Allow Bring Your Own Duel Gear
Allows duelists to use their existing equipment. Disabled by default because gear strength can make duels unfair.
Show Duel Arena Particles
Draws a particle ring around the active duel boundary for the dueling player.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.g: Combines same-type villager reputation tier notifications into one counted line.
Allows DESPISED reputation to interrupt an active hired job. Disabled by default; direct attacks can still trigger self-defense.
Allows villagers who personally DESPISE a player to target that player on sight.
Allows reputation events to supplement vanilla villager gossip where integration is available.
Allows named villager death messages to be broadcast when vanilla death messages are enabled.
Enables VillagerRetaliation custom adult villager drops.
Enables persistent per-villager, per-player reputation memory.
Enables VillagerRetaliation custom wandering trader drops.
Where villager reputation tier change messages appear: HUD, Chat, or Off.
Where the HUD reputation change feed is anchored on screen.
Visual style used by HUD reputation change notifications.
Shows the villager reputation icon and tooltip in the merchant trade screen.
Server-controlled toggle for rendering generated villager names above their heads.
Requires the player to hold an emerald before the villager reputation hover tooltip appears.
Controls which villagers show health and armor beneath their name: all villagers, hired villagers, party villagers in your party, or none.
Maximum positive gift reputation each player can earn with each villager per Minecraft day.
Allows trusted-or-better villagers to equip liked or loved gifts as keepsakes when possible.
Allows revered and royalty-tier villagers to occasionally give the player reward gifts.
Enables the gift flow in the Villager Retaliation interaction screen.
Hides reaction details until the player has already learned how that villager feels about the item.
Shows the villager's exact reaction to a hovered item on the gifting screen.
Minimum server-side interval between gift requests from one player.
Multiplier applied to positive reputation from additional stacks of the same item given to the same villager on one Minecraft day.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.n: Enables idle villager murmurs near players.
Enables retaliation, flee, attack-landed, and player-killed combat world-text indicators.
Enables villager damage and death alert world-text indicators.
Enables trade, gift, and trade-refusal world-text indicators.
Enables villager world-text indicators from notifications, dialogue, gifts, trade, and combat.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.p: Abandonment Ticks
Time without a living raider player in the village before defenders win.
Boss Bar Range
Extra blocks beyond the tracked village footprint where the raid bar is visible.
Confirm Raid Horn Use
Requires a second horn use in the same village within 30 seconds before declaring a Player Raid.
Defenders Per Golem
Player Raids
Allows a banner-helmet player to declare a raid by blowing a goat horn inside a tracked village.
Maximum Golems
Minimum Golems
Preparation Ticks
Time the raid bar fills while village defenses prepare.
Raiders Per Bonus Golem
Village Cooldown Days
Recovery time after a Player Raid ends, regardless of which side wins.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.q: Renders vanilla-style outline shader highlights on dropped quest items and third-person held quest items for this client.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.r: Container Break Reputation Loss
Base reputation change applied to a villager witnessing a player break a watched container.
Despised Sight Radius
Radius in blocks for DESPISED kill-on-sight checks.
Despised Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is DESPISED unless FEARED.
Direct Hit Penalty
Reputation change applied to a villager directly hit by a player.
Enable Reputation Trade Pricing
When true, per-villager reputation dynamically adjusts trade prices for that player.
Feared Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is FEARED.
Generated Container Break Item Reputation Loss
Additional reputation change per item stack count dropped from a generated watched container when broken.
Gossip Radius
Radius in blocks for villager-to-villager reputation gossip.
Gossip Reputation Multiplier
Multiplier applied when reputation spreads by gossip.
Heal Villager Gain
Reserved gain for detectable villager healing hooks.
Hostile Mob Assist Reputation Multiplier
Multiplier for positive reputation when the player damaged a hostile mob but did not receive kill credit.
Hostile Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is HOSTILE unless DESPISED.
Max Trade Reputation Gain Per Villager Per Day
Maximum positive trade reputation gain per villager per Minecraft day.
Positive Witness Gain
Reserved gain for witnessing village defense by a player.
Prune Neutral Entries After Days
Old neutral entries are pruned after this many Minecraft days.
Reputation Decay Amount
Reserved amount for future active reputation decay.
Reputation Decay Enabled
Enables lightweight pruning of old neutral reputation entries.
Reputation Decay Interval
Tick interval for reputation maintenance.
Reputation Trade Price Scale
Multiplier converting mod reputation into vanilla-style special price adjustments.
Respected Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is RESPECTED unless REVERED.
Revered Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is REVERED unless ROYALTY.
Royalty Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is ROYALTY.
Save Villager Gain
Reserved gain for detectable villager rescue hooks.
Sleeping Villager Bed Break Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when a player breaks the bed of a sleeping villager.
Sleeping Villager Bother Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when a player tries to interact with a sleeping villager.
Suspicious Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is SUSPICIOUS unless lower.
Trade Reputation Gain
Reputation gained by trading with a specific villager.
Trusted Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is TRUSTED unless RESPECTED.
Witnessed Baby Kill Penalty
Reputation change applied to nearby villagers witnessing a baby villager kill.
Witnessed Hit Penalty
Reputation change applied to nearby villagers witnessing a player hit another villager.
Witnessed Iron Golem Kill Penalty
Reputation change applied to nearby villagers witnessing an iron golem kill.
Witnessed Kill Penalty
Reputation change applied to nearby villagers witnessing an adult villager kill.
Witness Radius
Radius in blocks for witnessed reputation events.
Witness Reputation Requires Line Of Sight
When true, witnessed reputation changes require line of sight.
Aggro Duration Ticks
How long, in ticks, temporary villager anger lasts.
Attack Aggros Only Hit Villager
When true, damaging a villager only angers that villager.
Baby Villagers Flee Witnessed Deaths
When true, baby villagers that witness a villager death panic and flee like nitwit alarm witnesses. Disable to keep the original adult/nitwit-only witness behavior.
Killing Villager Aggros Nearby Villagers
When true, killing an adult villager angers nearby adult villagers.
Nearby Villagers Ignore Creative Players
When true, creative and spectator players are ignored as retaliation targets.
Retaliation Witnesses Require Line Of Sight
When true, nearby villagers and wandering traders only aggro from witnessed attacks or kills they can see.
Villager Kill Aggro Radius
Radius in blocks for nearby villager aggro after a villager is killed.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.s: Family-Aware Breeding
Prevents villager breeding pairs that violate tracked family relationship rules.
Opposite-Gender Pairing
Requires villager breeding pairs to have opposite tracked genders.
Inherit Parent Reputation
Allows baby villagers to inherit parent reputation entries when born or adopted.
Personality Effects
Allows villager Social Attributes to subtly affect moods, dialogue, reputation recovery, retaliation decisions, and gossip.
Enable Social Attribute Dialogue Effects
Allows Social Attributes and moods to lightly affect dialogue selection.
Enable Social Attribute Gossip Effects
Allows Social Attributes to subtly affect gossip and social reputation ripple.
Enable Social Attribute Mood Effects
Allows Social Attributes to shape temporary villager mood intensity and decay.
Enable Social Attribute Reputation Effects
Allows Social Attributes to subtly affect gifts, apologies, and reputation recovery.
Enable Social Attribute Retaliation Effects
Allows Social Attributes to subtly affect retaliation and combat readiness decisions.
Villager Moods
Tracks temporary event-driven villager moods used by dialogue and the interaction screen.
Villager Relationships
Tracks villager family and relationship profiles used by the interaction screen and dialogue conditions.
Social Attribute Effect Scale
Scales all Social Attribute behavior modifiers. 1.0 keeps the intended subtle Beta.12 values.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.t: Ignore Villager Wallet Limit
Lets villagers spend currency without checking their internal wallet balance. Useful for packs that do not use the wallet economy.
Skill Growth from Regular Trades
When true, normal villager trades add slow fractional progress toward the villager's primary profession skill.
Scale Trade Leveling by Skill
When true, a villager's primary profession skill slows or restores vanilla villager trade-level XP gain.
Show Skill Growth Feedback
Shows a subtle actionbar message to the trading player when a villager improves a skill through trade growth.
Skill Growth from Trade Levels
When true, villagers gain small profession skill increases once per newly reached vanilla trade level.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Skill Trades, Cycling & Requests
Enables the experimental skill-trade offers, trade cycling and refresh requests, and Special Orders. Disabled by default while these features are still in development.
Special Orders
When true, high-reputation players can place targeted Special Orders for targetable skill-trade definitions.
Regular Trade Skill Growth Amount
Primary profession skill XP per completed normal trade before daily and repeated-offer diminishing returns.
Skill-Based Trade Leveling Max Multiplier
Villager trade-level XP multiplier at the highest primary profession skill. Keep at 1.0 for high-skill villagers to level at vanilla speed.
Skill-Based Trade Leveling Min Multiplier
Villager trade-level XP multiplier at the lowest primary profession skill. XP-bearing trades still grant at least 1 visible trade-level XP.
Skill Growth Primary Max
Maximum point-equivalent XP bonus granted through normal progression at a trade-level milestone.
Skill Growth Primary Min
Minimum point-equivalent XP bonus granted through normal progression at a trade-level milestone.
Skill Trade Allow High-Tier Equipment
Allows Expert and Master smithing/crafting trades to offer diamond-tier equipment.
Skill Trade Allow Rare Specialty Trades
Allows rare Master-level skill specialty offers such as saddles, nautilus shells, and golden apples.
Skill Trade Allow Special Arrows
Allows high Archery fletcher trades to offer spectral arrows.
Apply Low-Skill Penalties
When true, low skill ranks can reduce skill trade counts, stock, rare chance, and increase base emerald costs for quality-scaled entries.
Skill Trade Max Enchantment Level
Maximum enchantment level used by skill-based trade rewards.
Scale Offers by Skill
When true, skill trade entries with quality_scaling enabled adjust count, base emerald cost, stock, rare chance, XP, and enchantment quality by skill rank.
Skill Trade Rare Chance Multiplier
Multiplier applied to rare skill-based offer chances.
Special Order Cooldown Days
Default Minecraft days before the same player can place another Special Order with the same villager when a trade entry does not override cooldown_days.
Special Order Extra Cost Enabled
When true, Special Order request metadata can charge an extra item cost when the request is accepted.
Special Order Max Active Per Player
Maximum active Special Orders each player can have with one villager at a time.
Special Order Min Reputation
Minimum per-villager reputation tier needed to place Special Orders.
Special Order Wait Days
Default Minecraft days before an accepted Special Order becomes ready when a trade entry does not override wait_days.

villagerretaliation.gui.profile.attribut: The score tells you how strongly that trait changes this villager's choices. It can affect dialogue, mood, reputation, gossip, and combat.

Profile attributes are not just personality labels. They change how this villager reacts to you and the world.
villagerretaliation.gui.profile.skills.i: Two relevant skills set each role's aptitude. Aptitude changes that role's concrete capability, such as capacity, block speed, accuracy, or action cadence, but does not gate ordinary jobs.
A higher score can unlock better, rarer, or more specialized offers. Villagers improve skills by trading and completing hired work.
A villager's main profession skill changes how quickly they level through trades. Relevant skills also decide which special offers they can sell.
villagerretaliation.gui.skills.title: Skills
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.ch: High Charm earns a little more reputation from friendly conversations and gifts. This villager also spreads gossip farther and to more villagers.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.gu: High Guts makes this villager less likely to flee when attacked and more willing to stand their ground. It also strengthens brave, proud, and protective moods.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.ki: High Kindness gives you more reputation for gifts, apologies, and shared victories. It also softens some negative reactions and makes caring moods last longer.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.kn: High Knowledge makes this villager's gossip carry more weight and strengthens suspicious moods. It also opens dialogue written for observant villagers.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.pr: High Composure helps this villager remain steady under stress and stand their ground when brave. It affects behavior and emotion, not learned job or combat performance.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.animal: Improves animal-related offers and Animal Handler job performance.

A higher Animal Handling score can unlock better animal-related offers. It is the main skill for Animal Handlers, so it has a strong effect on how quickly they work. Together with Farming, it sets this villager's Animal Handler aptitude.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.archer: Improves ranged offers, Hunting work, and Combat support.
A higher Archery score can unlock better bows, arrows, and ranged offers. It directly improves projectile accuracy and ranged attack recovery for Hunters and Combat workers.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.cartog: Improves map, navigation, and exploration offers.
A higher Cartography score can unlock better maps, navigation tools, and exploration offers. It is a cartographer's main profession skill, so it also helps cartographers gain trade levels faster.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.cookin: Improves food offers and Cook job performance.

A higher Cooking score can unlock better prepared food and ingredient offers. Together with Gathering, it increases how many materials a Cook collects per trip without changing furnace or smoker processing time.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.crafti: Improves workshop offers and several hired jobs.
A higher Crafting score can unlock better tools, repairs, and workshop offers. It increases Craftsman recipe speed, supports Logging block speed, and contributes to Builder construction cadence.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.diplom: Improves social offers and Nitwit job performance.

A higher Diplomacy score can unlock offers based on negotiation, trust, and village business. It is the main skill for the Nitwit role, so it strongly affects that worker's speed. Only nitwits can take that role.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.farmin: Improves farm offers and Farmer job performance.
A higher Farming score can unlock better crops, food, and farm supply offers. It is the main skill for Farmers and supports Animal Handlers. Those roles use it to set aptitude and improve work speed.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.fishin: Improves fishing offers and Fisher job performance.

A higher Fishing score can unlock better seafood, tackle, and water travel offers. It is the main skill for Fishers, so it has a strong effect on their aptitude and work speed. Survival provides the remaining support.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.gather: Improves natural resource offers and many hired jobs.

A higher Gathering score can unlock better forage, ingredients, and natural resource offers. It improves Logger block speed, Farmer cadence, Craftsman recipe speed, and the collection capacity of Couriers and Cooks.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.guardi: Improves defensive offers and Combat job performance.

A higher Guarding score can unlock better armor, weapons, and defensive supplies. It directly improves melee recovery and slightly modifies weapon damage. At 60, villagers can deliberately switch to an axe to break a blocking shield.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.leathe: Improves leather gear, saddle, dye, and tack offers.

A higher Leatherworking score can unlock better leather gear, saddles, dyes, and animal supplies. It is a leatherworker's main profession skill, so it also helps leatherworkers gain trade levels faster.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.masonr: Improves building offers, Builder work, and Mining support.
A higher Masonry score can unlock better stone, clay, brick, and building offers. It contributes to Builder construction cadence and supports a Miner's modest block-speed bonus.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.medici: Improves remedy offers and Brewer job performance.

A higher Medicine score can unlock better remedies, potions, and support supplies. Together with Scholarship, it speeds up prerequisite crafting and transfers into brewing stands without changing brewing time.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.mining: Improves ore offers, Mining work, and Smelter support.
A higher Mining score can unlock better ore, raw material, and excavation offers. It provides a modest Mining speed modifier after tool and block stats, and supports Smelter collection capacity.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.schola: Improves book and knowledge offers and supports Brewing.

A higher Scholarship score can unlock better books, lore, and research offers. It is a librarian's main profession skill, so it helps librarians gain trade levels faster. It also raises Brewer aptitude and work performance.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.smithi: Improves metal gear offers and Smelter job performance.

A higher Smithing score can unlock better tools, armor, weapons, and metalwork offers. Together with Mining, it increases how many materials a Smelter collects per trip without changing furnace processing time.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.surviv: Improves travel offers and supports several hired jobs.

A higher Survival score can unlock better travel, exploration, and wilderness offers. It supports Hunters, Fishers, Couriers, and Nitwits. Those roles use it to set aptitude and improve speed or carrying capacity.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.tradin: A higher Trading score can unlock rarer, more valuable, or better stocked merchant offers. Wandering traders and villagers without another trade specialty use this score when the game checks merchant-focused special offers.
